title: Young-Renter Charge on the Final Invoice (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Counter charge clause.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, a renter who is young at pickup, no older than the class's highest age for the young-renter fee, owes a young-renter charge on the rental, booked as one customer charge of the final invoice once the rental is returned and always the customer's.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Renters concerned | A renter whose age at pickup, as recorded on the reservation, is no older than the class's highest age for the young-renter fee |
| When it is booked | On the final invoice, once the rental is returned |
| Who pays | Always the customer, whatever covers the rental |
| Observable effect | One customer charge of kind young-renter appears on the final invoice in the rental's day and money history, dated the day it is posted, for the days it covers; the renter's outstanding share rises by its amount |

## Posting tool: `charge_young_renter_fee_a6a6d206`

**Capability.** Posts the young-renter fee to the renter's share of a returned replacement rental's final invoice. One customer charge of kind `young_renter` is added to the rental's day and money history, dated today, for the rental days it covers and the amount given; the renter's outstanding share rises by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_young_renter_fee_a6a6d206` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the rental reservation, as returned by the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `days_count` | Rental days the young-renter charge covers | Integer count of whole rental days, no fraction |
| `amount_usd` | Young-renter charge amount | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; rounded half-up to the cent when posted |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("posted" when the charge was recorded), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation charged), `charge_type` (always "young_renter"), `settlement_kind` (always "final"), `days_count` (integer rental days covered), `amount_usd` (the amount charged, USD with 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

A call with a reservation reference, a `days_count` of 4 and an `amount_usd` of 100.004 posts a charge of 100.00 USD covering 4 rental days, and the receipt reads `status` "posted", `charge_type` "young_renter" and `settlement_kind` "final".
